rows.caveat: Toumai only, acceptance-report basis, at HM Hospitales in Spain. This doubled the installed base in roughly six months. rows.name: Edge Medical
rows.caveat: This is NOT an installed base in the sense Intuitive uses. It merges machines physically installed and commissioned at an end user with machines merely delivered — including to distributors — so an unknown share of the 158 may be sitting in a channel rather than operating in a hospital. It is cumulative since first commercialisation in December 2022, covers all product lines including the single-port system, and is not a count of hospitals.

rows.name: Surgerii
rows.caveat: A single vendor's own disclosure counting hospitals, not necessarily machines — a hospital with two systems may count once. It covers domestic tertiary hospitals only and excludes overseas and any non-commercial or research placements. Vendor-disclosed figures across companies are not comparable because each defines placement differently, which is exactly why they cannot be summed into a national installed base.
